---
name: Mapping correction
about: Identify a contradiction or unsupported claim
labels: correction
title: "[Correction] field / document"
---

## Affected definition
Year, message, field and file. Quote only the relevant technical passage.

## Evidence and replacement
Explain what the current statement gets wrong, the proposed correction, independent reference and remaining uncertainty. Distinguish a different vehicle profile from an error in the observed profile.

## Privacy check
No identifying vehicle readings, routes, personal information or unreviewed source logs.
